description: Happy-path playoff scenario book with Bills/Packers anchors, exacta coverage, Bears ladder, and Dolphins ladder.

recommendations.market_view: Bears O9.5 is still plus-money at a placeable book while playoff pricing is closer to coin-flip territory.
recommendations.football_view: The schedule/rest context in the dossier is the supporting reason this can ladder into playoff optionality.
recommendations.thesis: Treat Bears O9.5 as the funding leg for a Bears playoff/Super Bowl ladder, not as an isolated futures bet.
recommendations.disconfirming_factor: The Bears still need proof that offensive efficiency catches up to the schedule advantage.

timing.expected_move: O9.5 could shorten if early schedule narrative gets steamed
timing.rationale: The ladder starts with the cheapest resolving leg.

recommendations.market_view: Dolphins O4.5 is plus-money while their playoff and AFC prices remain extreme optionality.
recommendations.football_view: This is a rebound-path stack, so the win total must be right before the AFC leg matters.
recommendations.thesis: Use the Dolphins over as a low-cost first leg that can subsidize a tiny playoff/AFC position if the season starts correctly.
recommendations.disconfirming_factor: If the team is actually bottom-tier, the playoff and AFC tickets become dead optionality quickly.

timing.expected_move: Could remain plus-money until market buys the rebound
timing.rationale: The ladder is more sensitive to team health than price alone.

watch.why: Useful exacta-style coverage against the Bills anchor if Detroit is the NFC path.

hedge_baskets.thesis: Small exacta-style tickets cover several playoff branches around the two anchors and major NFC/AFC gatekeepers.

legs.selection: Buffalo Bills vs Los Angeles Rams
Baltimore Ravens vs Green Bay Packers
Kansas City Chiefs vs Green Bay Packers

parlay_ladders.thesis: Bears O9.5 plus a playoff ticket creates a funding path for a later NFC/Super Bowl option.
Dolphins O4.5 is the cheap first leg; playoff/AFC are tiny continuation bets if the rebound thesis is alive.

coverage_positions: Buffalo Bills vs Los Angeles Rams
Baltimore Ravens vs Green Bay Packers
Kansas City Chiefs vs Green Bay Packers

ladder_stacks.intent: Use first two wins to lower liability on the Super Bowl option.
Keep AFC exposure tiny unless early legs are live.

playoff_hedge_plan.trigger: Bills reach AFC title game against Ravens or Chiefs
playoff_hedge_plan.action: Price opponent moneyline/conference hedge against Bills Super Bowl and exacta exposure.
playoff_hedge_plan.reserved_bankroll: Pocket hedge reserve plus any ladder profits.

playoff_hedge_plan.trigger: Packers reach NFC title game against Lions/Rams/Eagles
playoff_hedge_plan.action: Use matchup opponent price to protect Packers anchor while preserving exacta upside.
playoff_hedge_plan.reserved_bankroll: Preassigned reserve; do not add unless anchor equity is real.

stage1.portfolio_notes: This is a scenario book, not a list of isolated positive-EV bets.

verdicts.skeptic_note: Viable as a funding leg, but do not overstate the standalone edge.
verdicts.stronger_disconfirming_factor: The Bears ladder collapses if the offense stays merely average.

verdicts.skeptic_note: Treat as speculative rebound exposure only.
verdicts.stronger_disconfirming_factor: The low win total may reflect real roster/injury risk not captured by the stack.

finalized.portfolio_note: Keep the Bears ladder sized as a funded option path, not a core book position.
Only continue the Dolphins ladder if early health and performance confirm the rebound premise.

risk_editor.portfolio_notes: Scenario structures are useful, but the book is concentrated in Bills/Packers plus elite NFC/AFC paths.

scenario_review.max_exposure_note: Dead cost is acceptable only if exacta basket stakes are fractional units.
scenario_review.funded_liability_note: Bears and Dolphins ladders should be staked sequentially in practice; full exposure is the stress case.
scenario_review.coverage_note: Coverage spans Bills-NFC and Packers-AFC paths but still misses some non-anchor Super Bowl pairings.
scenario_review.concentration_note: Primary risk remains Bills/Packers concentration with Chiefs/Ravens/Eagles/Rams/Lions as the main opposing path cluster.
scenario_review.hedge_optionality_note: Pocket hedges should be priced only when playoff matchups and anchor equity are known.
